headline: Winter warming shelter funding of $900,000 at 166 Riverside Industrial Parkway postponed to November 2nd.
summary: The order would use $900,000 from the Opioid Settlement Fund for an emergency winter warming shelter at 166 Riverside Industrial Parkway. Staff said this location is the strongest option found so far, and members met in executive session to discuss other alternatives. The order was postponed to November 2nd, when public comment will be taken.
decisions: Postponed order 70-26-27, the $900,000 winter warming shelter funding, to November 2nd by an 8-0 vote.
discussion: Shelter background: Staff said last winter's shelter was not satisfactory to the community or the council, and earlier partners and locations did not work out.

Executive session request: Members of the public asked that alternatives be discussed in public, and one said the matter involved public property. Staff said the discussion concerned private property, and that terms would be shared before any action.
Postponement to November 2nd: The order was moved to November 2nd, and the chair said public comment would be taken on it then.

decision_evidence.quote: Move by Councilor Sykes, seconded by Councilor Lee. ... The attendees, this matter will be moved to date certain November 2nd, where public comment will be welcomed on the matter.

decision_titles: Winter warming shelter at 166 Riverside Industrial Parkway
